dedupe_keys.name: eelis estonian nature information system and its open wfs map service

description: EELIS, the Estonian Nature Information System run by the Estonian Environment Agency, holds the state register of protected natural objects, water bodies and related environmental features, and publishes them through an open OGC web feature service (WFS 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and 2.0.0) with 59 layers. The layers include protected areas, Natura 2000 bird and habitat areas, Ramsar sites, limited management zones, springs and karst areas, publicly usable lakes and watercourses, catchments of hydrometric and hydrochemical stations, lake and river water bodies, groundwater and coastal water bodies, former dams, water abstractions, boreholes with their sanitary protection zones, wastewater collection areas and treatment plants, outfalls, residual pollution sites, nitrate-sensitive areas, areas at risk of flooding, Estonian mires, woodland key habitats and invasive species sites. Unless a layer says otherwise, the data is open under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence with credit to the Environment Agency, and access is free. Caveats: the service states that the data is informative and its future availability is not guaranteed, and some layers carry their own terms. Coverage is Estonia. It supports green and blue infrastructure planning, flood hazard exposure and screening of roads, pipelines and power lines against protected areas and water protection zones; related records are the AOPK Czech nature conservation data and the Swiss federal biodiversity inventories.
